name: Claude Opus 5.5
description: Claude Opus 5.5 is a step-change improvement over Opus 5 for agentic coding, long-running agentic tasks, knowledge work, communication, and vision. It is more token-efficient per completed task and reports progress, findings, and next steps in clear language.
